title: Typing
description: Train speed and accuracy with adaptive lessons, tests, passages, code and shortcut drills.

modeHints.adaptive: Letters unlock one at a time as you get fast and clean on the ones you have.
modeHints.test: Common words against the clock or a word count.
modeHints.quotes: Short original passages: everyday life, making things, travel, food and science.
modeHints.code: Real-looking snippets with brackets and operators. Indentation is typed for you.
modeHints.shortcuts: Press the chord for each action. Builds muscle memory for app shortcuts.
modeHints.fn: Reach the keys on your Fn layer, or drill symbols and numbers.
modeHints.custom: Paste any text and practise it.

options.stopOnErrorHint: The cursor waits until you press the right key.
options.lightKeyboardHint: Next key glows white, mistakes flash red on your real keyboard.
options.fingerGuideHint: Colour keys by the finger that should press them.
options.layoutHint: Used to show which key makes each character (Ñ, accents, symbols).
options.targetWpmHint: Every unlocked letter must reach this speed with 95 % accuracy before the next one unlocks.

ghost.raceHint: Show a ghost caret replaying your personal best for this test.
ghost.invalid: That file is not a KeyHalo result with a replay.
ghost.none: No personal best for this test yet — finish one to race it.

hints.start: Start typing — the clock starts on your first key.
hints.focusLost: Click here or press any key to focus

adaptive.pseudo: Few real words fit yet, so some practice words are invented from common letter pairs.
adaptive.resetConfirm: Reset adaptive progress for {lang}? Unlocked letters and per-letter averages will be cleared.

drill.noFn: Your keyboard has no Fn-layer data, so this drill practises symbols and numbers.

results.heatmapHint: Slow or missed keys glow warmer.
results.bigramsEmpty: Type a bit more to see letter pairs.

progress.noBests: Finish a test with at least 90 % accuracy to set a personal best.
progress.lettersHint: Ring = readiness (speed and accuracy against your target).
progress.clearConfirm: Delete all typing history, personal bests and key statistics? Adaptive progress is kept.
progress.emptyHint: Finish a run in Practice and your progress shows up here.

custom.title: Custom text
custom.placeholder: Paste or type the text you want to practise…
custom.hint: Smart quotes and dashes are converted to plain keyboard characters.

share.ghostSaved: Ghost saved — send the file to a friend to race you
